verdict.rationale: A personal AI agent platform could plausibly publish versioned developer APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents neither a public versioned API nor any deprecation policy. Probes found no public OpenAPI spec (HTTP 401), and the api.muse.ai origin returned 404 on /v1/ping with no discovery or spec route. Muse writing connectors to other services' APIs is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
